description: This PHP class provides a translation mechanism for the Revive Adserver project, wrapping translation memory loading and string translation functions.

classes.name: OX_Translation
classes.description: Provides translation functions, including loading translation files and translating strings with optional HTML escaping and debugging features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the translation object, optionally loading a translation file based on the provided path and current language setting.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a string using loaded translation memories, with support for variable substitution, HTML escaping, and debugging display.
